Why We Do What We Do

Uttarakhand faces a significant challenge with stray animals. Many are injured, malnourished, or abandoned. LAHIT was born from a simple belief: every animal deserves compassion and care.

Our team of dedicated volunteers works around the clock to rescue animals in distress, provide medical treatment, ensure daily feeding, and find loving forever homes through adoption.

Every rescue is a journey of hope. See how your support helps transform injured and abandoned animals into healthy, happy companions.

DehradunJanuary 2024

Meet Bruno

Found injured on roadside in Dehradun. Had a severe leg wound and was malnourished. Rescued and treated by volunteers. Now fully recovered and living happily with his new family.

Dog
Before
After
MussoorieFebruary 2024

Meet Luna

Abandoned near Mall Road with severe skin infection. Received intensive care and love. Transformed into a beautiful, playful cat now enjoying her forever home.

Cat
Before
After
UttarkashiMarch 2024

Meet Rocky

Hit by a vehicle and left unable to walk. Our team rushed him to the vet. After surgery and physiotherapy, Rocky is now running and playing like any healthy dog.

Dog

After
RishikeshDecember 2023

Meet Mithu

Found with a broken wing in a local market. Nursed back to health over two months. Now flying free and even learning to mimic our volunteers!

Parrot

HaridwarNovember 2023

Meet Kali

Severely malnourished mother dog with puppies. All were rescued and cared for. Puppies found homes, and Kali is now a healthy, happy companion.

Meet Bella
